statement: For an m-state discrete HMM with pi>0 and rank(O)=rank(T)=m, iid length-three observation triples suffice for LearnHMM(m,N) to produce a rank-m observable operator model whose length-t joint distribution has L1 error at most epsilon with probability at least 1-eta, provided N meets Theorem 6's bound C*t^2/epsilon^2*[m/(sigma_m(O)^2 sigma_m(P21)^4)+m*n0(epsilon0)/(sigma_m(O)^2 sigma_m(P21)^2)]*log(1/eta), epsilon0=sigma_m(O)sigma_m(P21)epsilon/(4t sqrt(m)).
source: Hsu-Kakade-Zhang, arXiv:0811.4413v6, Conditions 1-2, Sections 3.1-3.2, Figure 1, Theorem 6, Appendix A / Section 5.1; https://arxiv.org/abs/0811.4413
supplied: requested error epsilon, confidence eta, horizon t
acquired: empirical P1, P21, and P3,x,1 from observation triples
cost: N independent triples = 3N observed symbols; theorem has a universal unspecified constant C and real-arithmetic SVD/pseudoinverse; finite-precision bit runtime is not supplied by the source.
boundary: Fixed-rank theorem; not rank-free. Joint L1 at a requested horizon, not pointwise word error.

statement: With column-stochastic T, P1=O*pi, P21=O*T*diag(pi)*O^T, and P3,x,1=O*T*diag(O[x,:])*T*diag(pi)*O^T. For any U with U^T O invertible, b1=U^T P1, b_infty=(P21^T U)^+P1, and Bx=(U^T P3,x,1)(U^T P21)^+ satisfy b1=(U^T O)pi, b_infty^T=1^T(U^T O)^-1, Bx=(U^T O)Ax(U^T O)^-1 and telescope to all word probabilities.
boundary: The empirical b_infty formula must use P-hat_1. Figure 1 prints P_1 unhatted, whereas Section 5.1's proof uses P-hat_1; this record flags the likely source typo.

statement: Under HKZ Condition 1, rank(P21)=m. From an independent pilot of N_r iid triples, let q_r=n*sqrt(log(2*n^2/delta_r)/(2*N_r)), let R_r=q_r+zeta for certified singular-value error zeta, and return m_hat=#{j: sigma_tilde_j(P-hat21)>2R_r}. If sigma_m(P21)>=4R_r, then m_hat=m with probability at least 1-delta_r. Using an independent fitting batch of N_f triples and LearnHMM(m_hat,N_f), the joint guarantee is at least 1-delta_r-delta_f when N_f satisfies HKZ Theorem 6 at the true m.
proof_method: Cellwise Hoeffding over n^2 pair events, Frobenius-to-operator bound, Weyl singular-value perturbation, and independence of pilot and fitting batches.
explicit_margin_setting: For sigma_m(P21)>=mu>0, zeta<=mu/8 and N_r>=32*n^2*mu^-2*log(2*n^2/delta_r) imply R_r<=mu/4 and exact rank selection.
cost: N_r+N_f independent triples; rank pilot costs 3N_r symbol events and uses n^2 exact counters of ceil(log2(N_r+1)) bits. The conservative pilot sample bound is O(n^2*mu^-2*log(n/delta_r)).
boundary: Conditional on a positive pair-moment singular margin and certified finite-precision SVD. Does not remove HKZ fitting margins or prove a uniform gap-free rank guarantee.

statement: The source supplies statistical sample bounds and arithmetic-level SVD/matrix product descriptions, but no certified finite-precision bit complexity for computing Uhat, pseudoinverses, or stable Bhat operators. Empirical moment counts themselves have exact rational encodings with O(log N) bits per counter; the remaining numerical precision/runtime must be separately specified.
scope: This is a source guarantee boundary, not a proof that no efficient certified implementation exists.
